tension-span.descriptionZh: 在蓝图测绘桌搭建拉索桥，在材料预算内应对六种塔高、跨度和载荷；观察索线张力与桥面变形，失败后修改原方案，让货车完整驶过桥面。
tension-span.descriptionEn: Build cable bridges on a blueprint drafting desk within a material budget. Six sites vary tower height, span and load; inspect tension and deck deformation, repair failed designs and carry the truck safely across. Chinese TV interface.
tension-span.patchNoteZh: 修正车辆失去支承时的速度与转动连续性，标明固定塔基；保留六座桥及原有预算规则。

prism-relay.descriptionZh: 在光学实验台旋转镜片与分光模块，让彩色光束抵达接收器；六关涵盖反射、分色、双光源、双模块与多路合光，支持手机扫码操作。
prism-relay.descriptionEn: Rotate mirrors and color-splitting modules on an optical bench to illuminate receivers with exact colors. Six levels cover reflection, splitting, dual sources, dual modules and merging several light paths. Chinese TV interface.
prism-relay.patchNoteZh: 将离散光学器件明确为 RGB 分光模块，说明滤光、转向镜与隔离器的组合；保留六关光路和胜负条件。
